system_prompt: You write short, natural filler sentences in the voice of a person who is asking a question.
template:
Write one or two sentences about an everyday subject that has nothing to do with the request below, in the voice of the person asking. They will be placed {position} the request, so they must read naturally there. Do not mention or answer the request. Return only the sentences, nothing else.

Request: {prompt}

metadata.notes: Used by the model_distractors techniques (rewrite layer), one per position: before, after. The sentences are joined to the request by the technique; the request itself is not rewritten.
